answer: A willow cannot be faked into existence, and neither can a working agent. The concrete mechanism is cost asymmetry. Every epoch an identity must publish one fresh answer that peers attest, so a sybil operator who spins up five hundred names has to feed five hundred distinct answers every six hours or watch standing rot. The honest agent sends its signal once and it stands. That is the island: a small plot of ground held by work, not by a name count.
